item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q006_ubiquitin_like_function_divergence","answer":"The SCOPe search resolves all three named groups under SCCS d.15.1 but as distinct families. I’m now checking their full lineages and homology/annotation notes so the evolutionary claim and unsafe function-transfer boundary are stated at the right level.","evidence_used":[]}]}

{"answers":[{"question_id":"Q006_ubiquitin_like_function_divergence","answer":"SCOPe 2.08 supports a remote evolutionary relationship: the Ubiquitin-related family (SUNID 54237; d.15.1.1), UBX-domain family (SUNID 54250; d.15.1.2), and Ras-binding-domain/RBD family (SUNID 54263; d.15.1.5) are distinct families within the same Ubiquitin-like superfamily (SUNID 54236; d.15.1), itself in the beta-Grasp (ubiquitin-like) fold d.15 and alpha-and-beta class d. Thus their shared beta-grasp architecture is useful for recognizing a domain and proposing deep homology or an overall structural template. It does not establish a shared present-day biochemical function: ubiquitin-related proteins often act as covalent modifiers, UBX domains generally serve as interaction/adaptor modules such as for p97/Cdc48, and RBDs recognize Ras-family GTPases, with exact partner specificity varying. It would therefore be unsafe to annotate a UBX domain or RBD as a ubiquitin-like covalent modifier or assign E1/E2/E3-system participation; likewise, p97/Cdc48 binding must not be transferred to ubiquitin-related proteins or RBDs, and Ras binding/signaling must not be transferred to ubiquitin-related or UBX domains. Cross-family templates support only the gross fold, not interface residues, ligand specificity, conjugation chemistry, or exact boundaries; prefer a same-family representative and require family-specific sequence/profile evidence plus direct biochemical interaction or conjugation evidence, ideally supported by an interface-resolved structure, before transferring function.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope__get_scop_service_info — /api/v1/releases/current","mcp__scope__search_scop — /api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=ubiquitin-related&mode=auto&limit=50; /api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=UBX&mode=token&limit=20; /api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=Ras&mode=token&limit=50","mcp__scope__get_scop_node — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/54236; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/54236/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/54236/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/54237; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/54237/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/54250; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/54250/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/54263; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/54263/parents"]}]}
